_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO. Trimestre 3 (primavera), días 131-195: tres palabras al día; llegan las otras formas de escribir los sonidos (ay, ou, ie, ea, oy, ir, ue, aw, ew, oe, au, ey, wh, ph, tch, dge), la e mágica (c-a_e-k) y dos consonantes seguidas (n-e-s-t). Palabras de hasta cinco sonidos. Cada viernes presenta unas pocas tricky words ('tricky'), que se leen enteras: las que llevarán las frases del verano.

actividad.prompt: Amy is eight! At her birthday party, she has got a green dress, a party hat, a badge with a star and two balloons. Colour her.
Amy's birthday cake looks like Pip: it is green! Colour the cake, and draw its eight candles.
Amy's presents: a toy parrot, a purple hat and a drawing of Toby.
Colour Amy's party in the garden: the flags, the balloons and the cake -- and Amy and Lucía, so happy!
Lucía and Amy paint eggs. One is blue with white spots, and one is yellow with red stripes. Colour them!
the Easter bunny hiding a chocolate egg next to a flowerpot.
Lucía looking up and finding the last egg, on the fence between the two gardens.

actividad.adivinanza: I am small and yellow, I come out of an egg, and I say “cheep, cheep”. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the basket full of Easter eggs, each one painted in a different way.
In the park, Toby sees a red squirrel. The squirrel runs up the tallest tree, and Toby barks at the bottom. Colour them!
Toby runs past the pond and into the bushes, and now he is lost! Colour the pond and the bushes, and draw Toby hiding in them.
Toby's red ball under the bench, and muddy paw prints next to it.
Colour Pip with the paper medal that Lucía made for him. Pip is a hero!
Mr Brown is cleaning Pip's cage in the garden, and Pip flies out of the open door! Colour Pip flying over the garden.
Pip on a high branch of the chestnut tree, hiding in the leaves.
the green feather that Lucía finds on the fence: a good clue!

actividad.adivinanza: I have got lots of steps, and Mr Brown climbs up me to get to the high branches. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the poster that Lucía and Amy made: LOST PARROT, with a big picture of Pip.
For Book Day, everyone makes a book, and Amy writes a story about Pip. On the cover, Pip is in a tall tree, and a dog is barking at him. Colour it.
On Book Day in England, Amy was a witch, with a cloak and a broom. Colour her, and draw her tall witch's hat!
Lucía's book: Toby runs fast, but he can't catch the squirrel!
Colour the cover of a book about space: a rocket flying to the moon, with lots of stars.
Marta brings a box with five tiny caterpillars that eat green leaves. They are black, with a yellow stripe. Colour them on their leaf.
the caterpillars hanging from the lid, each one in a hard brown case.
five butterflies drying their orange wings.

actividad.adivinanza: I am tiny, a butterfly puts me on a leaf, and a little caterpillar comes out of me. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the butterflies flying away, and the last one landing on Amy's hair.
Sam has got a new bike! It is red, with a yellow bell and a little basket at the front. Colour it.
Sam's new bike is not finished: a wheel is missing! Colour the bike, and draw its back wheel.
Sam on his bike, and Dani shouting “Go, Sam, go!”
Colour Lucía on her bike, riding in the park.
It is Mother's Day! Dad, Lucía and Dani make Mum a surprise breakfast on a tray: toast like hearts, orange juice and coffee. Colour the tray.
the rose for Mum, in a vase, hidden in the fridge!
the card for Mum: a red flower, a white one and a pink rose, in a blue pot.

actividad.adivinanza: I am grey, and I go up and up. When the toast gets black and burnt, I come out of the toaster! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour Mum with her flowers, and Lucía and Dani saying “Happy Mother's Day!”
Today Dani is six! His chocolate cake has got six blue candles and a green dinosaur in the middle. Colour Dani and his cake.
Lucía makes a treasure hunt for Dani. The first card is under his pillow, and it says: “Look in Dad's socks!” Colour the pillow, and draw the socks on the card.
“These are for you!” Dani's present: a blue bike with a big bow.
Colour the treasure at the end of the hunt: a box full of chocolate coins -- and Toby wants some too!
The two families go to the zoo! At the gate, a monkey sits on the sign, and a giraffe looks over the wall. Colour them.
the penguins, swimming very quickly in the water. Splash!
the two monkeys hanging from the ropes, and the little one with his banana.

actividad.adivinanza: I am long and grey, and I am on an elephant's face. The elephant drinks with me and says hello with me! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the lion at the zoo, with his big, fluffy mane, sitting in the sun.
Marta's class goes to a farm. In the pen, there is a sheep and a goat called Lola. Lola is the cutest goat, with brown spots! Colour them.
Someone left the gate open, and a goat is munching the cabbages! Colour the goat and the cabbages, and draw the open gate.
the donkey eating a carrot, and a hen in her nest, with her eggs.
Colour the farm: the red barn, the donkey, the goat, the sheep and the hen.
It is Sports Day! Lucía and Amy are in the yellow team: yellow T-shirts with a green star, and green caps. Colour them.
the egg-and-spoon race: Lucía walking slowly, with her egg on a spoon.
Dani jumping in his sack, all the way to the finish line!

actividad.adivinanza: I am long and soft, and you wear me round your neck when it is cold. On Sports Day, Marta ties Lucía's leg and Amy's leg together with me! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Colour the medal that says “Winner!” -- and Pip trying to eat it.
The class makes a big card for Marta, with a red heart that says “Thank you, Marta!” and yellow stars around it. Colour it.
It is June, and summer is coming! Colour Lucía with her sun hat and her ice cream, and draw a big, hot summer sun.
the present for Marta, hidden under her desk: a plant in a pot.
Colour the friends saying goodbye to spring, with Toby, Pip, the flowers and the butterflies!
